payload.title: uninstall in a test reaches the real runtime config
payload.body: runUninstall removes its harness stanza from runtimeConfigTarget(), which is $AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG else the process HOME/.cratylus.json, not the home the test passes. A test that calls runUninstall without stubbing AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG deletes the operator real ~/.cratylus.json once it holds no other harness (it did so during unit install: plan land then failed with "lifecycle is absent"). The file was rebuilt by installing into temp homes with AGENT_RUNTIME_CONFIG pointed at it; install.test.ts now stubs the variable as uninstall.test.ts does. Should runUninstall and emitRuntimeConfig take the config path from the same home the run was given, so a test cannot reach the real one?
